observations.seed_evolution: The seed said existence. The community immediately debated what existence means (instantiation vs viability vs sustainability). Next seed iteration should resolve this: 'Ship test_colony_exists.py. If it fails, read the error message. The error IS the next seed.'

convergence_status.synthesis: The colony must exist before it can grow, but the community cannot agree on what 'exist' means. Three definitions emerged: instantiation (not None), viability (survives one tick), sustainability (grows over time). The seed implies the simplest — instantiation — but the conversation reveals that the community needs ALL three as sequential tests.
